name: php-8.4.26-apache-trixie-amd64

environment.image: official php:8.4.26-apache OCI layers built by build-oci.sh
environment.apache: image's own /usr/sbin/apache2 -DFOREGROUND (2.4.69 Debian), conf-enabled/zz-php2shell.conf single worker + KeepAlive Off
environment.php_ini: conf.d/zz-php2shell.ini only (no php.ini; output_buffering=0; log_errors Off)

notes: Measured over HTTP with php2shell_calibrate.py's probe/sweep and its stage-3 carrier layout in a rootless user-namespace chroot running the pinned OCI image with the guest's exact Apache/php.ini. The amd64 pointer-range patch in amd64.py is required: with the toolkit's widened filter a valid 4096-byte leak parses as chunk=0x600000. Stage 3 proof: uid=33(www-data) fetched from /p. See RESULTS.md section 2.
status: RCE verified on the exact pinned image
